We visited Nude Food Café as a group of five and, unfortunately, the experience didn’t go as well as we hoped. Although we were told the wait would be around 20 minutes, we ended up waiting 1.5 hours for a table, while others seemed to be seated much faster. The staff and owners were polite, but the communication about wait times needs improvement, and there were no proper waiting arrangements.

On the positive side, the café has a great eco-friendly concept with a zero-waste food policy, which I really appreciate. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, even though the space feels a bit small and crowded.

The coffee was excellent, the chicken pie was tasty (could’ve used a spicy note), and the pasta dishes were nice, though one was slightly undercooked and could have used more spice. Portions felt a bit small for the price.

Overall, while the café’s concept and ambience are lovely, the extremely slow service and long wait time took away from the experience. Expanding the seating area or managing reservations more clearly would help a lot.

featured_reviews.name: Mandar Keny
featured_reviews.review_text:
Shivraj Dhaba Karad, located in Prabhadevi, Mumbai, offers a taste of authentic highway-style pure vegetarian cooking right in the city. It’s the perfect place for anyone craving hearty North Indian and Maharashtrian dhaba food.
The atmosphere is simple and purely functional—don't expect fancy decor or quiet dining. It’s often busy and buzzing, giving it a genuine roadside feel which enhances the experience. Service is generally quick and efficient, even during busy weekend hours.
The menu is quite limited, but the real stars are the spicy Maharashtrian curries and rich preparations. Their fresh Bhakri and Tandoori Rotis are essential for scooping up the flavorful gravies. If you like bold, rustic flavors, definitely try the signature Akkha Masura which is the star . The portions are enough for 2 people , which means you get excellent value for your money.
Overall, this is a wonderful spot for a satisfying meal that feels truly authentic and homemade. It’s a great choice for families and friends looking for delicious, spicy comfort food at reasonable prices. Shivraj Dhaba Karad is highly recommended for a genuine dhaba experience without leaving Mumbai.

The place is always crowded, so be prepared to wait outside for at least 20–40 minutes. The seating area is small, but the food makes it completely worth the wait. Prices depend on the current fish rates.
We tried the special prawns thali, which comes with double portions of prawns fry absolutely delicious. Also had the surmai thali with two fried pieces, and the taste was awesome. The bhakri was soft and fresh.
The best part was the unlimited solkadi, along with tasty crab lollipop. Service was quick too—food arrived within 5–10 minutes. Highly recommended for seafood lovers!

Don't miss having it with kombdi wade(its made of traditional flour mixed and fried nice and fluffy) or ghavne (Rice flour). Along with this all, they will also serve Solkadi (its a drink made of nice blend of wild mangosteen fruits along with some garlic and coriander, its amazing drink) do not miss this.

And to conclued this tasty food have parole (made of Rice flour and grated coconut,sweetened by jaggery with lot of ghee)

You must visit to this place and do try the amazing food of Indian west costline. This place will not disappoint you at all..

featured_reviews.review_text:
This review is for a delivery experience with this restaurant.

This place has decent reviews from its customers and hence decided to order from here. The ordering process was navigated smoothly and got a confirmation within 2 minutes regarding acceptance of the order. The order was delivered well within the promoised timelines.

I had ordered the following from their kitchen:

ONION KULCHA [INR 40]
Coarsely chopped onions which were tossed in oil, were patted on top of a refined flour [Maida] Kulcha. Frankly, it didn’t seem like a Kulcha to me, it was a Naan; since Kulcha dough has to be essentially kept aside and allowed to rise. Also the fact that the filling was not stuffed inside the Kulcha but patted on the surface didn’t make sense to me.
It was very rubbery in feel &ntexture as well.

GOBHI KULCHA [INR 50]
This Kulcha was also prepared in the same manner as Onion Kulcha; hence it didn’t curry any favour with me.

ALU MUTTER [INR 145]
This was the most decent preparation of my order though it was made excessively oily. The flavor of the spices and onions used in the gravy was spot-on, the peas were cooked properly yet whole and chunks of boiled potatoes added bulk to the whole dish. When such dishes come my way, I hold a lid on top of the container and tilt it to drain away the excess oil or use a slice of bread to absorb it.

I will try ordering again from here though I have reason for doing so.

featured_reviews.name: Vinayak Londhe
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had seen a reel on Instagram about this restaurant and since I stay nearby in Prabhadevi, I thought of giving it a try. Honestly, the overall experience was very average, and I don’t think I would want to visit again.

First thing I noticed was that the menu was quite overpriced. Still, I decided to taste some of their delicacies to see if the quality matched the pricing. Unfortunately, it did not live up to expectations. The only fun part was when my mom liked the way they served Fanta in a wine glass – we all had a laugh at that.

We had ordered:

Chicken Manchow Soup (₹180): This was actually good, no complaints here.

Crispy Chicken (₹440): Okayish, nothing memorable.

Chicken Lollipop Fry (₹380 for 8 pcs): This was good and well-prepared.

Murg Makhanwalla / Butter Chicken (₹330): Taste was fine but the portion was very small for the price.

Rotis (₹20 each), Chapatis (₹20 each), Butter Naan (₹60): Normal.

Half Chicken Fried Rice (₹150): Surprisingly tasty and probably the best value-for-money dish we ordered.

On the positive side, the ambiance was good, and their homemade Schezwan chutney deserves special mention. It was flavorful, prepared without artificial colors and with minimal oil – definitely something I appreciated.

But when I look at the overall food quality compared to the prices, it simply wasn’t worth it. Some dishes were decent, but the portions were small, and the flavors didn’t stand out. With so many better and more reasonably priced options available nearby, I don’t see myself coming back here.

featured_reviews.name: rajesh jaiswar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Flavours Of China in Prabhadevi is a solid go-to spot for Indo-Chinese and Thai cuisine, especially if you’re looking for tasty food at reasonable pricing in the South Mumbai area.

🍽️ Food:
The food is definitely the highlight here. Their menu offers a wide variety—from classic Chinese gravies and noodles to Thai curries and rice. Dishes like burnt garlic rice, Manchurian, and Thai curries stand out for their bold flavours and generous portions. The taste is consistent, slightly on the Indianised side (which most people prefer), and perfect for comfort dining. Many customers also appreciate the freshness and customizable options available.

🥢 Portion Size & Value:
Portions are quite generous, making it ideal for sharing. Pricing is pocket-friendly for the quality and quantity offered, making it a great value-for-money option in the area.

🏠 Ambience:
The ambience is simple and casual—not a fine dining place, but clean and comfortable for a quick meal with friends or family. Seating space is slightly limited, so it can feel a bit cramped during peak hours.

🧑‍🍳 Service:
Service is generally quick, especially for takeaway and delivery orders. However, during busy hours, there can be slight delays and service could be more attentive.

📍 Location:
Conveniently located in Prabhadevi near Century Bazaar, it’s easily accessible and a popular neighbourhood dining spot.

⸻

✅ Pros:

* Delicious Indo-Chinese flavours
* Generous portion sizes
* Good value for money
* Wide menu variety (Chinese + Thai)

featured_reviews.name: Maryam Farhat
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’re looking for a unique dining experience in Mumbai, this Spanish restaurant is an absolute gem. The moment you step in, you’re welcomed by stunning, intricately designed interiors that perfectly capture the essence of Spain. The ambiance is romantic and elegant, with soft lighting and a warm, inviting vibe, making it ideal for a cozy date night or special occasion.

The restaurant offers two distinct sections: one for an intimate dining experience and another that’s more vibrant, catering to those looking to party and enjoy a lively atmosphere. Both spaces are beautifully crafted, ensuring a memorable time no matter the occasion.

When it comes to food, the menu is a delightful journey through Spain’s finest flavors. Whether you’re craving perfectly cooked steaks, fresh seafood, or indulgent pasta dishes, this place has it all. The steaks are juicy and tender, the seafood is fresh and flavorful, and the pasta dishes are packed with rich, authentic taste. The desserts, too, are not to be missed – they’re the perfect sweet ending to your meal, with every bite being a little piece of heaven.

Overall, this Spanish restaurant in Mumbai excels not only in its beautiful interiors and dual atmosphere, but also in its exceptional food. Whether you’re in the mood for a romantic evening or a night of partying, this spot is sure to impress. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy great food and a memorable experience and it’s just 5 mins away from the sea-link

Wow! Thank you for such a beautifully detailed review. We’re thrilled that you loved our ambiance, food, and dual dining experience. It’s our goal to bring the true essence of Spain to Mumbai, and knowing that we made your visit special means the world to us. We can’t wait to welcome you back for another unforgettable evening!

Best regards,
Team Milagro
